question: The Ancient Monuments Preservation Act was enacted in the year _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1904.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Ancient monuments Preservation Act** was passed in the year **1904.**
 
• It was an Act to provide for the **preservation of Ancient Monuments and objects of archaeological, historical, or artistic interest.**
 
• It was passed during the time of** Lord Curzon.**
 
• This Act preserves and restores ancient Indian monuments by** Archaeological Survey of India (ASI).**
 
• **ASI department **was made to collect the historical documents and importance, conduct excavations and bring the ancient historical information into the light.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Archeological Survey of India (ASI):

 
 
• ASI was founded by Alexander Cunningham in 1861.
 
• He also became its first Director-General.
 
• Sir Alexander Cunningham was a British army engineer with the Bengal Engineer Group.
 
• Alexander Cunningham was appointed to the **n**ewly created position of an archaeological surveyor to the government of India in 1861.
 
• The (ASI) Archaeological Survey of India is an Indian government agency attached to the Ministry of Culture.
 
• ASI is responsible for archaeological research and the conservation and preservation of cultural monuments in our country.
